events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball goes out of bounds off Jackson Jr. (MEM).
Towns (MIN) sets the screen on Rabb (MEM) and does not deliver contact.

Towns (MIN) dos not establish himself in a screening position in the path of Rabb and turns and extends his backside into Rabb which causes Rabb to trip over the left foot of Saric which creates illegal head to head contact.
Rabb is not in a legal guarding position as he leans into Saric (MIN) who does not make an unnatural movement as the two players bang heads..
Rabb (MEM) sets the screen on Wiggins (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Rabb (MEM) firms up in Bayless's (MIN) path while setting the screen and absorbs contact. Although some contact occurs to his leg, he is not in a wide stance.
RAR shows Conley (MEM) kicks out unnaturally into Bayless's (MIN) path during his jump shot attempt and initiates contact that does not affect Bayless's ability to defend.
Saric (MIN) sets the screen on Conley (MEM) and does not deliver contact.

Jackson Jr. (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position on Bayless (MIN) as he moves along his path during the driving shot attempt. Head contact is marginal as a result of Bayless moving into Jackson Jr.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) sets the screen on Bayless (MIN) and does not deliver contact.
Deng (MIN) makes contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
After receiving the hand off Wiggins (MIN) hops from his left foot to his left foot.
Holiday (MEM) makes marginal contact with Wiggins's (MIN) arm during his shot attempt as Jackson Jr. (MEM) cleanly blocks the shot.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Towns's (MIN) shot attempt.
Saric (MIN) moves into Conley (MEM) and initiates contact that affects his SQBR and causes him to carry the ball.
Deng (MIN) does not intentionally kick the ball.
Wiggins (MIN) takes more than two steps after he has gathered the pass.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes contact with Towns's (MIN) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes marginal contact with Okogie (MIN) while disengaging from the screen and does not affect his ability to defend.
RLB shows Conley (MEM) extends his arm into Tolliver (MIN) and initiates contact that dislodges him from his defensive position and affects his ability to defend the jump shot attempt.
Okogie (MIN) steps on Holiday's (MEM) foot and dislodges him from his position after the rebound.
